keep_features.feature_value: Directly addresses the reader with 'you' / conditional questioning
keep_features.evidence_span: "If you believe Conservatives..." "why would there be discussion"
keep_features.rationale: Uses second-person 'you' in repeated conditional questions to address the reader.

keep_features.evidence_span: "Sign the petition telling Congress to vote YES"
keep_features.rationale: Contains an imperative urging users to sign a petition.
Includes several high-profile news organizations in @mention form.

keep_features.feature_value: Advocates background checks requirement as a policy
keep_features.evidence_span: "requires background checks on all gun sales"
keep_features.rationale: States a specific gun-policy mandate as a requirement.
Uses derogatory phrasing to belittle an opposing position.

keep_features.feature_value: Frames outsiders/ICE agents as incompetent/thuggish vs safer community outcomes
keep_features.rationale: Contrasts a targeted group (ICE agents) with community harms/insecurity.

keep_features.feature_value: Rhetorical 'vote in a lockstep' claim contrasted with examples in two sections
keep_features.evidence_span: "What do you mean by \"vote in a lockstep\"" "But about locksteps:"
keep_features.rationale: Uses question framing and then a contrasting 'But' section to structure argument.

remove_features.rationale: Contains explicit taboo word 'fuck' used as intensifier.

remove_features.feature_value: Quantified economic/job losses and spending impacts
remove_features.evidence_span: "$8B in annual visitor spending lost" "50,000 jobs at risk"
remove_features.rationale: Uses dollar amounts and job impacts as justification/argument.

remove_features.feature_value: Stigmatizes nonvoters as deserving insult; lists harms from gun/anti-choice/gerrymandering
remove_features.evidence_span: "They deserve to be insulted" "Gun laws that kill kids"
remove_features.rationale: Blames a group and foregrounds harm-causing policies as reasons.

remove_features.feature_value: Religious expletive / emphatic intensifier 'for Christ's sake'
remove_features.rationale: Uses a religious intensifier/expletive to heighten emotion.

remove_features.feature_value: Accuses NRA/GOP of being complicit in acceptable killings; frames as extremist 'DOMESTIC TERRORIST'
remove_features.evidence_span: "the NRA became a DOMESTIC TERRORIST organization" "complicit GOP"
remove_features.rationale: Uses extreme delegitimization and claims of complicity in lethal outcomes.
Concludes with an evaluative taunt targeting a person.

remove_features.feature_value: Moral hypocrisy labels using life/death rhetoric ('So "pro-life"!')
remove_features.evidence_span: "So \"pro-life\"!" "more children could die in school shootings"
remove_features.rationale: Invokes moral stance labels to condemn hypocrisy, tying it to deaths.
Uses blunt, informal derogatory labeling aimed at a political group.
